name: whisper-large-v3

resources.realTimeFactor: ~1-2x on consumer GPU; ~55x on dedicated A100

notes: Full-accuracy multilingual Whisper. Slower than turbo but the only option for audio→English translation (turbo was distilled without translation data). Best choice when accuracy matters more than throughput, or when translation is needed. WER ~2.7% on LibriSpeech test-clean, ~8-12% on real-world English.
